title: Espresso Yourself Coffee Meet-Up
description: Join us for a casual coffee meet up at an LGBTQ-affirming business, Coffee Fellows, to meet other LGBTQ+ community members and allies. Grab a coffee, tea, pastry or whatever suits your fancy, and make new connections or even get some work done. Enjoy a safe space of community and allyship!
